# FLX-5023: the Simulation declares no time window

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

The engine runs every Simulation on a virtual clock that starts at `timeBounds.start` and ends at `timeBounds.end` in the Simulation's `spec` (KERNEL-SPEC section 7): signals are scheduled inside that window, and a DATE or TIMESTAMP column with no draw of its own is drawn from it. The FLUX schema leaves `timeBounds` optional, so the FLUX reference validator (`python3 -m flux_spec.validate`) passes a Simulation without one, but this engine has no window to run it in. Add `timeBounds` under the Simulation's `spec` with a `start` and an `end`, each an RFC 3339 instant with an offset (`Z` for UTC), the start before the end. `fluxsim validate` refuses the bundle before anything runs, and `plan` and `run` give the same refusal.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5023
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
